policy: Third-party source trees are generated locally; only this lock and explicit patches belong in the project repository.

components.name: arduino
components.notes: The project currently uses a minimal IDF component manifest and selective compilation. Convert the local CMake delta into an explicit patch before a clean bootstrap is required.

components.notes: The component is the src/components/bluepad32 subtree with ESP32-S3 driver selection changes.

components.name: bluepad32_arduino

components.name: btstack
components.notes: BTstack is the revision used by Bluepad32 4.2.0, not an independently selected floating branch.
